result:
Done. I've created an autostart recovery system that will automatically restart sync after the box reboots:

**What I set up:**

1. **`scripts/autostart-sync.ps1`** — PowerShell script that runs at startup and triggers the sync, logging results to `data/startup.log`

2. **`scripts/register-autostart.bat`** — One-time setup script (run as Administrator) that registers a Windows Task Scheduler task to run the autostart script at system startup

3. **`scripts/unregister-autostart.bat`** — Removes the scheduled task if needed

4. **Updated README** — Documents how to enable and manage the autostart

To activate it, open Command Prompt as Administrator and run:
```
scripts\register-autostart.bat
```

After the next reboot, sync will restart automatically and log the result to `data/startup.log`. You can verify it's working by checking that log file.
